GENERATE BURST K1-gen-02 — Keeper identity masters, second set with Matt's notes (charter § 7 K1: '+3 with Matt's notes'). task_id "K1-gen-02".

Deliver EXACTLY THREE independent candidates of the SAME figure, one image_gen call each, from the description below — do not vary the design between candidates. Names: out/k1_master_D.png, out/k1_master_E.png, out/k1_master_F.png. NO retries: three calls total; calls_used must equal 3.

DESCRIPTION (use it verbatim as the content of each call):
Keeper of Hours — STARTER identity master, v2. One full-body figure, facing the camera (direction S), projection C (elevated three-quarter), standing, feet visible, weight even, arms relaxed, a plain wooden staff held upright in the RIGHT hand. Identity: a YOUNG WOMAN, early 20s, dark curly hair tied back, sun-browned skin, face fully visible, no helmet — read clearly as feminine in face and build while keeping the practical archivist bearing. Costume (every item is an instrument or carries one): ivory linen shirt with rolled sleeves under a navy wool sleeveless tabard whose chest is PLAIN — no emblem, no ring, no shape of any kind; ONE chestnut leather harness strap running from the right shoulder diagonally to the LEFT hip where it carries an olive waxed-canvas satchel with brass corners; ONE chestnut leather waist belt whose buckle closes the tabard; chestnut leather laced bracers on both forearms; navy wool trousers; chestnut leather buckled boots. Staff: a plain dark walnut shaft with small brass ferrules at the foot and the tip — NO ring, NO head-piece, NO shape atop it. NO insignia anywhere on the character: every surface is plain and undecorated — no trim, no edge ornament, no sigils, no compass diagrams, no studs. Register: painted 2D, illustrated, clean material planes, restrained surface texture, no conspicuous brush or pixel grain. Light: single key from SCREEN UPPER-LEFT, deep cool low-value ambient, readable shadows never pure black, slight rim on the key-facing edge; no spell glow; NO floor shadow. Flat uniform pure #00ff00 background covering the whole canvas; do not matte. Image 1 is the IDENTITY REFERENCE for hair mass, costume, materials, pose, framing and register — keep all of that — but CHANGE three things: the figure is a young woman; the tabard chest is plain (remove the ring emblem); the staff ends in a plain tip with a brass ferrule (remove the ring head).

Copy each output from $CODEX_HOME/generated_images/... to out/ with the exact names above and compute its sha256. No code. No other files. No web. No agents.
RETURN: the receipt (task_id "K1-gen-02"): images = the three files with prompt, references (role + path), elapsed_s; calls_used = 3; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS / FAILED; concerns naming anything you could not honour. Never PASS/FAIL.

references.role: IDENTITY REFERENCE (master B): keep hair mass, costume, materials, pose, framing and register; change three things — young woman; plain tabard chest (no ring); plain staff tip (no ring head)
